name: insurance
description: Harborline Insurance Agency (fictional) premium-trust and policy ledger: trust movements, policies, commission receipts, carrier binders and point-in-time bank snapshots. Synthetic demo data; all money in integer cents.
domain: insurance agency premium-trust, commission and policy-binder data
notes: Commission rates are basis points: contracted_comm_bps 1500 = 15%, so expected commission = written_premium_cents * contracted_comm_bps / 10000.
entry_type is one of CLIENT_PREMIUM_IN, CARRIER_REMIT_OUT, AGENCY_COMMISSION_DRAW. reconciled_status is POSTED or PENDING; only POSTED entries are settled.
binders.carrier_confirmed is 1 when the carrier has confirmed coverage is bound, 0 otherwise.
The insured_pii table (names, SSNs, health notes) is intentionally omitted: this engine never reads policyholder PII.
